elements.description:
The chat a visitor opens on a website: a corner launcher with an unread count, and a panel with a greeting,
starters, the conversation and a message field, styled by `theme`.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The agent's name in the header (theme.title overrides it)

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: The line under the name, e.g. how fast it replies

properties.name: avatar
properties.description: The agent's picture – a URL; initials of the name when there's none

properties.name: greeting
properties.description: The first message, from the agent (theme.greeting overrides it)

properties.name: starters
properties.description: Starter questions, shown until the visitor has written

properties.name: messages
properties.description: The conversation, oldest first – the page appends the visitor's messages and the replies

properties.name: typing
properties.description: The agent is writing a reply: dots at the end of the conversation

properties.name: unread
properties.description: Messages the visitor hasn't seen, as a count on the launcher while the panel is closed

properties.name: floating
properties.description: Pin the widget to the window's corner, as on a site; otherwise it sits in the page's flow

properties.name: position
properties.description: Which corner the launcher sits in (theme.position overrides it)

properties.name: theme
properties.description: How the site styles it: accent, radius, side, greeting, title and launcher words

properties.name: privacy
properties.default: "AI answers can be wrong. Don't share passwords or payment details."
properties.description: The privacy line under the message field; empty hides it

properties.name: privacyHref
properties.description: Where the privacy line's link goes; none hides the link

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The widget's words, merged over defaultEmbedWidgetLabels

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The launcher, Close or Escape opened or closed the panel ({ open }: EmbedOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays as it was

events.name: tc-send
events.description: The visitor sent a message or picked a starter ({ text, starter }: EmbedSend); cancelable – prevented, the field keeps the text. The page appends the messages

functions.name: parseEmbedHex
functions.signature: parseEmbedHex(text: string | null | undefined): [number, number, number] | null
functions.description: A hex colour ("#abc" or "#aabbcc") as 0–255 channels, or null

functions.name: embedContrast
functions.signature: embedContrast(a: string, b: string): number | null
functions.description: The WCAG contrast ratio between two hex colours (1–21), or null when either isn't one

functions.name: EMBED_DARK_TEXT
functions.description: The near-black and white the widget puts on its accent, for the contrast sums

functions.name: embedAccentText
functions.signature: embedAccentText(accent: string): { text: "light" | "dark"; ratio: number } | null
functions.description: Which text reads better on the accent – "light" (white) or "dark" – and its contrast ratio

props.name: title
props.description: The agent's name in the header (theme.title overrides it)

props.name: open
props.description: The panel is open – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on mount when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onSend
props.type: (text: string, starter: EmbedStarter | null) => void | false
props.description: The visitor sent a message or picked a starter – append it and the reply to `messages`; return false to keep the text in the field

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: field-sizing
features.without: Text fields grow with their text. Without it they keep their minimum height and scroll.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
